AUTO_ANTHONY_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Randomly generates card effects for each run. Currently in open beta and supports all five characters.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SETTINGS_PAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The settings page could not load its native controls.
AUTO_ANTHONY_ENABLED_DESCRIPTION: Enables or disables random card pools. Takes effect in the next run; existing saves and run history remain usable.
AUTO_ANTHONY_ENABLED_ON: Auto-Anthonyology enabled. New runs will generate random card pools.
AUTO_ANTHONY_ENABLED_OFF: Auto-Anthonyology disabled. New runs will use the original card pools; existing saves and run history are unaffected.
AUTO_ANTHONY_REPLACE_STARTING_CARDS_DESC: Replaces original Basic cards and the starting deck with generated Basic cards. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_REPLACE_STARTING_CARDS_ON: Starting-card replacement enabled. New runs will use generated Basic cards and a generated starting deck.
AUTO_ANTHONY_REPLACE_STARTING_CARDS_OFF: Starting-card replacement disabled. New runs will keep the original Basic cards and starting deck.
AUTO_ANTHONY_ULTIMATE_CHAOS_DESCRIPTION: Removes character component restrictions and generates generally stronger, denser cards. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_ULTIMATE_CHAOS_ON: Ultimate Chaos enabled. Every character will use the same shared, stronger generation profile in new runs.
AUTO_ANTHONY_ULTIMATE_CHAOS_OFF: Ultimate Chaos disabled. New runs will use each character's normal component pool.
AUTO_ANTHONY_NUMERIC_BALANCE_OPTIMIZATIO: Makes generated values more stable and closer to the original game overall. Takes effect in the next run.
Numeric Balance Optimization enabled. New runs will use the stable, original-like value distribution.
Numeric Balance Optimization disabled. New runs will use the default aggressive value distribution.
AUTO_ANTHONY_CARD_INTERNAL_IDS_DESCRIPTI: Shows the internal ID used by console commands in a card hover tip.
AUTO_ANTHONY_CARD_INTERNAL_IDS_ON: Card internal IDs are now shown.
AUTO_ANTHONY_CARD_INTERNAL_IDS_OFF: Card internal IDs are now hidden.
AUTO_ANTHONY_GENERATION_MODE_HOVER_TIPS_: Shows active Chaos Mode and Numeric Random Mode generation rules as the first hover tip on generated cards.
Card mode hover tips are now shown.
Card mode hover tips are now hidden.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_DESCRIPTION: Hides unseen cards' descriptions, costs, tips, and previews in acquisition screens. Seeing a card elsewhere reveals it for the run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_ON: Surprise Mode enabled. Surprise Mode Lite and Pro have been disabled.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_OFF: Surprise Mode disabled. Card descriptions and costs are now shown.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_LITE_DESCRIPT: Replaces 80% of unseen card text with ■ and hides its cost, tips, and previews in acquisition screens. Seeing the card elsewhere reveals it.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_LITE_ON: Surprise Mode Lite enabled. Surprise Mode and Pro have been disabled.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_PRO_DESCRIPTI: Permanently hides generated-card descriptions, tips, and previews everywhere. Costs become visible after obtaining the card.
AUTO_ANTHONY_SURPRISE_MODE_PRO_ON: Surprise Mode Pro enabled. Surprise Mode and Lite have been disabled.
AUTO_ANTHONY_RANDOM_CARD_ART_DESCRIPTION: Randomly selects card art from the original game and enabled card-art mods. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_RANDOM_CARD_ART_ON: Random Card Art enabled. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_RANDOM_CARD_ART_OFF: Random Card Art disabled. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_NUMERIC_RANDOM_MODE_DESCRIP: For every non-cost card value: 50% uses 0%-100%, 40% uses 100%-300%, and 10% uses 300%-500% of its generated value, with a minimum of 1. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_NUMERIC_RANDOM_MODE_ON: Numeric Random Mode enabled. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_NUMERIC_RANDOM_MODE_OFF: Numeric Random Mode disabled. Takes effect in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_PRESERVE_ORIGINAL_CARDS_DES: Keeps original non-Basic cards alongside generated cards. Takes effect in the next run; Basic cards are still controlled by Replace Starting Cards.
AUTO_ANTHONY_PRESERVE_ORIGINAL_CARDS_ON: Original non-Basic cards will be preserved in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_PRESERVE_ORIGINAL_CARDS_OFF: Original non-Basic cards will be replaced in the next run.
AUTO_ANTHONY_OPTIMIZE_HISTORY_DONE: Old run history has been optimized.
AUTO_ANTHONY_OPTIMIZE_HISTORY_FAILED: Some histories could not be optimized. Every original was preserved; check the log and retry.
AUTO_ANTHONY_NUMERIC_RANDOM_MODE_HOVER_D: This card's non-cost values were independently randomized after generation.
AUTO_ANTHONY_CHAOS_MODE_HOVER_DESCRIPTIO: This card was generated from the shared component pool without character restrictions.
AUTO_ANTHONY_CHAOS_AND_NUMERIC_RANDOM_MO: This card was generated from the unrestricted shared component pool, then had its non-cost values independently randomized.
